item.description: Endpoints to query junction registration, configuration, queues, and live signal telemetry (Section 10.1 & 10.3).

item.name: 2. Sensor Events (Vehicle Detection)

request.description: Ingests vehicle arrival event. Increments queue count and triggers scheduling evaluation.

response.name: Vehicle Arrived (Forklift - Priority 15)

request.description: Ingests high-priority material truck on EAST approach.
Section 7 Emergency Preemption: Immediately begins safe transition (YELLOW 5s -> ALL-RED 2s -> WEST GREEN).
Removes a vehicle after it clears the intersection. Prevents queue from becoming negative.
Section 4 & 10.2 Idempotency Requirement: Exact duplicate event_id is safely acknowledged (200 DUPLICATE_IGNORED) without modifying queue multiple times.

response.name: Idempotency Test (Duplicate Event ID)

item.description: Vehicle arrival and departure events ingested from roadside IoT sensors (Section 10.2, 4, & 5).

item.name: 3. Manual Supervisor Control

request.description: Section 8 Manual Override: Initiates safe transition to WEST/EAST green.

response.name: Manual Green Request (WEST)

request.description: Requests manual green for NORTH approach.

response.name: Manual Green Request (NORTH)

request.description: Returns junction to AUTOMATIC state machine scheduling.

item.description: Administrative control commands enforcing safety transition sequence (Section 10.4 & 8).

item.name: 4. Physical Controller Hardware Telemetry

request.description: Simulates physical hardware confirming requested signal state.
Section 9 Failure Handling: Puts junction into DEGRADED mode with desired ALL-RED safety fallback while preserving unconfirmed physical telemetry.

response.name: Simulate Controller OFFLINE (Degraded Fallback)

request.description: Restores controller to ONLINE status and resumes normal operation.

response.name: Simulate Controller ONLINE Restoration

item.description: Physical signal controller state acknowledgements and hardware failure telemetry (Section 10.5 & 9).

item.name: 5. Audit History & Simulation Helpers
